title: Chapter 557 - 557 The Award Ceremony Begins; I Will Endure It!

Chapter 557 - 557 The Award Ceremony Begins; I Will Endure It!

Chapter 557 - 557 The Award Ceremony Begins; I Will Endure It!

557 The Award Ceremony Begins; I Will Endure It!

Imperfect romance?

Lin Xiaoyao pursed her lips and said, “A cultured person really knows how to lie to himself.”

Liu Zihao could not help but let out another dry cough. He pretended as if he had not heard Lin Xiaoyao’s words. He did not say anything else.

…

When Lin Fan, Lin Xiaoyao, Liu Zihao, and the others walked into the Golden Hall, the host Xiao Bing was standing in front of the camera with a microphone. She smiled and said, “Hello to the audience in front of the TV. I’m the host, Xiao Bing.

“Today, I’m honored to be here at the Nobel Prize award ceremony in Swede.”

“Today, Professor Lin Fan will receive the Nobel Prize in chemistry, medicine, physics, and the Nobel Peace Prize.

“I believe that most of the viewers have heard of Professor Lin Fan’s name. However, you may not know much about him.

“Let me give you a simple introduction to Professor Lin Fan’s contributions.

“Mathematics is the foundation of all scientific research! Professor Lin Fan solved Zhou’s Conjecture, the Twin Prime Number Conjecture, Hail’s Conjecture, Hodge’s Conjecture, Riemann’s Hypothesis, and many other difficult problems that had plagued the world for hundreds of years. He had even won the Fields Medal!

“Physics contains the secrets of the world! Professor Lin Fan developed an earthquake prediction device that allows us to predict geological changes just like how we predict the weather. This greatly reduces the damage that nature does to us!

“Chemistry is the magical transformation of everything. Professor Lin Fan invented super batteries and other high-tech products, allowing us to use cleaner and more efficient energy.

“Medicine contains the password of the human body! Professor Lin Fan developed the human islet recovery drug, allowing hundreds of millions of diabetes patients to see the dawn of health!”

Xiao Bing’s voice rose and fell in a high pitch…

She was extremely excited, and even her pretty face turned red.

In fact…

Xiao Bing was not the only one who was excited. The audience sitting in front of the screen was equally excited.

Today, all the major video websites were broadcasting the live broadcast.

As the audience listened to Xiao Bing’s words and watched the lively scene, their moods surged.

Countless bullet comments poured down like rain.

Prodigal Son: [Xiao Bing, I love you!]

Zhong Bei: [I’m too excited! I can’t believe Professor Lin Fan won four Nobel Prizes! Also, Xiao Bing is mine!]

Stone: [Xiao Bing’s introduction is really awesome.]

Useless Scholar: [I heard that the parents of the winners can also go to the Nobel Prize award ceremony. From now on, I have to nurture my child well.]

Love You Forever: [It’s so lively.]

Person in the Mirror: [Where’s Professor Lin Fan? I don’t think I’ve ever seen his photos or videos on the Internet. I wonder if I’ll have the chance today.]

Dejected: [I haven’t seen his face either.]

Xinghe: [We’ll definitely be able to see him today.]

…

At this time, Xiao Bing suddenly said, “That’s Mr. Liu Zihao. The young man beside him… It’s Professor Lin Fan!”

Then, the camera locked onto Lin Fan’s back.

The bullet comments in the live broadcast room instantly filled the entire screen.

Heart Like Still Water: [Is this Professor Lin Fan? Although it’s just his back view, he looks so handsome!]

NEO: [Didn’t they say that scientists have receding hairlines? But Professor Lin Fan’s hair is so thick!]

Fate: [I love you!]

Snow Flower: [I’m begging you to show Professor Lin Fan’s face!]

One, Two, Three: [He’s so handsome!]

…

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to all of this.

In fact, there were many other reporters at the scene. They all turned on their cameras to record the scene… They kept sweeping the camera across everyone.

All of these cameras, without exception, would have their signals cut off when they landed on Lin Fan.

At this moment, a burst of light music sounded in the huge Golden Hall.

Then, an old man wearing glasses, who looked extremely gentlemanly and intelligent, slowly walked onto the stage.

He cleared his throat and spoke in English, “Thank you very much for coming all the way to the Golden Hall to attend this year’s Nobel Prize award ceremony. I’m Alders, and I’m very honored to be the host of this year’s Nobel Prize.”

The venue immediately erupted into a round of applause.

Many people might not know Alders.

However, most of the people who participated in the Nobel Prize were famous scholars or people of high status.

They knew that Alders was a great scholar and a member of the royal family of Switzerland.

It could be said that he was a person with both knowledge and status.

With him as the host, it showed the importance he attached to this year’s Nobel Prize.

After a while, Alders said, “Scientific research and literature are long and boring. It’s hard to see results in a short period of time.

“Our Mr. Nobel is one of such researchers. He knows these hardships very well.

“Therefore, before he died, he selflessly kept all his wealth.

“He wanted to let all researchers have the opportunity to research, create, and learn without having to worry about food!

“Today, we’ll follow Mr. Nobel’s wishes and award medals to scientific researchers and writers who have made great contributions to physics, chemistry, medicine, peace, literature, and so on!”

The venue once again erupted into extremely enthusiastic applause.

Everyone’s hearts started to beat faster.

Lin Xiaoyao, who was standing beside Lin Fan, whispered, “Brother, I’m suddenly so nervous. What should I do? I feel like peeing.”

Lin Fan rolled his eyes and said, “It’s not like you’re going to receive an award. What are you nervous about? It should be because you drank too much black tea in the morning. The bathroom seems to be in that direction. Go.”

Lin Xiaoyao shook her head and said, “That won’t do. The award ceremony is about to start! I’ll endure it!”

Lin Fan smiled and shook his head.

…

In front of the camera, Xiao Bing said excitedly, “Everyone, according to the procedure, it should be the official award ceremony next. Please don’t miss it.”

As she spoke, her entire pretty face became even redder.

Rheia: [Finally, it’s time for the awards!]

Black and White: [Hurry up, Professor Lin, come on stage!]

Invisible: [I’m so excited.]

Free as the Wind: [Professor Lin is awesome!]

…

After the applause ended, Alders took a deep breath. Under everyone’s gaze, he slowly reached out and flipped open the thick cover page in front of him.

“The winner of this year’s Nobel Prize in Physics is…”
